principle: Strong models plan and judge; light models execute. Model choice is explicit per role and verified at dispatch time.

heavy.description: Core theory derivation, novelty judgment, adversarial review. Use only for reasoning that changes the research direction.
heavy.fallbackNote: GLM-5.3 has limited quota; use only when both Astra and Sol are unavailable.

light.description: Literature retrieval, numerics execution, file and tool work, summarization.
light.fallbackNote: Volcano Ark first (deepseek-v4.1-flash / glm-5.3-flash); when quota is exhausted use SquareAPI deepseek-flash-1017. DeepSeek official flash is not registered as a Pi provider here, so it is not in the chain.

vision.description: Visual and aesthetic work: figure layout, poster, presentation.
vision.imageNote: Prefer the logged-in web GPT-Pro for publication figures; gpt-image models are for illustration, not precise diagrams.

literature.description: Literature retrieval uses agy with a Gemini flash model, not a Pi subagent model.
literature.note: Facts from agy still require first-party verification.

research-strategist.note: Proposes directions; must not also judge them.

research-reframer.note: Only invoked when stuck; output needs critic review.

research-explorer.note: Two parallel explorers must use different model families when possible.

research-web-oracle.note: Operates the browser; the scientific answer comes from the web model the user selects.

constraints.heavyModelPolicy: ChatGPT Pro quota is spent only on Astra high/xhigh and Sol max/high. Never bind 5.6-luna, gpt-6-luna or unlisted models for heavy roles.
constraints.independenceCheck: A derivation pair must use two different model families; same-family pairs are recorded as correlated, not independent. The jury must differ from both derivations.
constraints.actualModelRecording: Every dispatch records requested model and observed model; gate compares observed, not requested.
constraints.fallbackMustBeLogged: Any fallback or downgrade is written to the ledger with the reason.
constraints.externalProfileLimit: codex-exec and claude-code profiles do not support model override; a model-pinned review cannot be routed through them.

resourceGate.note: Unified with AGENTS.md. Must stay above earlyoom's ~10% threshold (about 768 MiB).
